verses: A Poem, A Psalm of David.
My heart is firm, O God; I will sing, I will give praise; my glory likewise.
Awake the harp and the lyre: I will awaken the dawn.
I will praise Thee, O Lord, among the peoples: and I will sing praises to Thee among the nations.
For Thy steadfast love is great above the heavens: and Thy truth reaches the clouds.
Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and Thy glory above all the earth;
that Thy beloved ones may be delivered: save with Thy right hand, and answer me.
God has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shekhem, and measure out the valley of Sukkot.
Gil῾ad is mine; Menashshe is mine; Efrayim also is the strength of my head; Yehuda is my sceptre;
Mo᾽av is my washpot; over Edom will I cast my shoe; over Peleshet I will cry in triumph.
Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me to Edom?
Hast Thou not rejected us, O God? so that Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
Give us help against the foe: for vain is the help of man.
Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is who will tread down our enemies.
